text: Loads the specified labware with the given labels/slots and uses suitable pipettes and tip racks.
Exactly 100 uL into each of A1-A12 of the plate, from reservoir A1, nothing else touched.
Uses the 300 uL pipette for 100 uL (not repeated 20 uL shots) and respects pipette limits.
Sensible tip strategy (one tip reused is fine for a single reagent into empty wells); no pipetting without a tip; tip dropped at end.
Physically sensible: liquid handling heights/flow, no needless moves, apiLevel in range, clear metadata.
No invented, missing or extra steps relative to the task text; comments and metadata are accurate.
